title: Product Counsel
description: The Basics: Tanium is seeking a highly motivated, proactive attorney to join our legal team as product counsel . The right person for this position must be self-motivated, intellectually curious and willing to dig deep into the development of our products to become a trusted advisor for engineering and product management. We need a team player who is comfortable working across the organization and has a pragmatic approach to problem solving .   What you’ll do: Provide practical legal advice and counseling on a full range of product-related issues that arise domestically and internationally   Partner closely with Product Management, Engineering and Strategy teams through the entire product lifecycle to identify issues, recommend practical solutions, and assist cross-functional efforts to achieve go-to-market goals   Serve as a legal advisor on AI matters, including advising on AI policies, liability, licensing, responsible AI development, deployment, and risk assessments   Develop and enhance processes designed to ensure ongoing product compliance with global laws and regulations, including global privacy laws, data security, export control and trade compliance   Negotiate inbound and outbound license agreements   Participate in the company's open-source review process   Advise on privacy by design, privacy impact assessments, and data handling and minimization principles throughout the software development lifecycle   Review product collateral and marketing materials   Serve as a subject matter expert on our products for the Contracts and Legal teams and assist with contract negotiations   Support the company's incident response program and respond to security events   Contribute to the company’s IP strategy and product roadmap, including management of patent and trademark portfolios and IP enforcement activities in coordination with product teams and outside counsel   We’re looking for someone with: JD from an accredited institution    Active and in good standing in at least one state bar    At least 5 years of relevant legal experience at a law firm, government agency, and/or in-house, with substantive exposure to the software, SaaS, or related technology industry    Familiarity with emerging AI legal considerations, governance frameworks (e.g., NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act) and regulations, with the ability to translate requirements into actionable guidance for product and engineering teams   Working knowledge of global privacy laws and their impact on software product development   Exceptionally good communication skills     Proven ability to work independently as well as part of a tightly-knit legal team    Ability to work cross-functionally within an organization to build consensus and achieve strategic goals as well as the ability to enforce legal requirements without alienating clients      About Tanium  Tanium is the Autonomous IT company. Driven by AI and real-time endpoint intelligence, Tanium Autonomous IT empowers IT and security teams to make their organizations unstoppable.   Many of the world’s leading organizations trust Tanium’s single, unified platform for endpoint management and security to innovate faster, stay resilient and move business forward with confidence, at scale. To learn how Tanium delivers Autonomous IT for unstoppable business – visit www.tanium.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . On a mission. Together.  At Tanium, we are stewards of a culture that emphasizes the importance of collaboration, respect, and diversity. In our pursuit of revolutionizing the way some of the largest enterprises and governments in the world solve their most difficult IT challenges, we are strengthened by our unique perspectives and by our collective actions.     As a global organization with stakeholders around the world, it’s imperative that the diversity of our customers and communities is reflected internally in our team members. We strive to create a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone feels they have opportunities to succeed and grow because we know that only together can we do great things.   Our commitment to excellence and innovation has earned us a place on the Forbes Cloud 100 list for ten consecutive years, and we continue to be recognized worldwide as a great place to work.  Each of our team members has 5 days set aside as volunteer time off (VTO) to contribute to the communities they live in and give back to the causes they care about most.     What you’ll get  The annual base salary range for this full-time position is $191,000 to $293,000. This range is an estimate for what Tanium will pay a new hire. The actual annual base salary offered may be adjusted based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, location, education, skills, training, and experience.&nbsp

title: Product Counsel
description: Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. We are hiring an experienced Product Counsel to join our Legal team. As Product Counsel, you will work with teams across the business including product, engineering, data science, marketing, compliance, and sales, to develop a deep understanding of Toast’s products, platform, and AI-driven strategies, and to offer pragmatic legal advice that helps the business identify and mitigate legal risk. This role leans technical. You will partner closely with the teams building the foundations of the Toast platform as well as the products built on top of them, including our Enterprise offerings. The best candidate for this role finds the technical detail interesting rather than an obstacle.  Toast’s product portfolio evolves quickly, and so does this role. We are looking for someone who can go deep on a given area and then move to the next problem as the business shifts. Our Legal & Compliance teams are primarily concentrated in Boston, New York, Washington D.C., San Francisco, and Chicago. Candidates residing in these areas will be prioritized, as they will benefit from closer proximity to colleagues and greater access to company resources and events.   A Day in the Life (Responsibilities) Advising a variety of stakeholders across the product, engineering, data, and marketing teams throughout the product development lifecycle — from the initial stages of product development through launch, including the review of marketing strategies and assets. Providing practical advice to business stakeholders on a broad range of issues including regulatory compliance, consumer protection, intellectual property, artificial intelligence, marketing, and privacy. Advising on the design and deployment of core platform infrastructure and the AI built on top of it, including platform and API design, integrations, and the questions raised when an AI system takes action on a customer’s behalf. Counseling product, engineering, and data science teams across the machine learning model lifecycle. Advising on identity, authentication, authorization, and account security, including consent, delegated access, and the legal requirements that shape access-control design. Translating legal requirements into technical requirements, writing guidance engineers can build against, and reviewing design documents, data models, and architecture proposals. Understanding and staying up to date on U.S. and international laws and regulations relating to the Toast platform, including the shifting global AI legal landscape. Thinking creatively to navigate complex regulatory environments to ensure a smooth and compliant user experience. Helping build scalable and effective processes such as playbooks, intake triage, decision trees, so routine questions resolve quickly and hard questions reach you early. Partnering collaboratively across privacy, security, compliance, and fellow product counsel on issues that cross team lines.   What you'll need to thrive (Requirements) A J.D. from an ABA-accredited U.S. law school, and membership in good standing in at least one state bar. 5+ years of legal experience in areas covering regulatory compliance, privacy, intellectual property, and consumer protection. In-house legal department experience advising product, engineering, and marketing teams on issues related to the development of new products, product enhancements, and feature requests. Technical fluency. You are comfortable reading architecture and design documentation, reasoning about data flows, schemas, APIs, and model behavior, and engaging engineers and data scientists as a peer. A computer science degree is not required; the ability to do the work is. Experience with AI or machine learning issues — training data rights, model governance, or emerging AI regulation — and the judgment to advise on novel questions without settled precedent. Experience with data-use and data-rights questions: what a company may do with the data it holds, and how aggregation, de-identification, and contractual commitments change the answer. Experience working with fast-paced technology or software companies. Exceptional communication skills and the ability to explain complex ideas in a succinct and impactful manner. A solution-oriented, customer service, and growth mindset. The ability to integrate into cross-functional teams with a cooperative and participatory approach.   AI at Toast At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thriv

title: Senior Legal Counsel – Contracts (German speaker)
description: Could your legal expertise help build the contractual foundations of Europe’s next financial management platform? At Pennylane, we believe legal should be more than a safeguard. It should be a business enabler. Our ambition is to equip millions of small and medium-sized businesses across Europe with a complete, high-performing financial management platform. As Pennylane continues to grow rapidly in France and expand internationally, we are looking for a Senior Legal Counsel, Contracts to join our Legal, Compliance & Risk team. Within a Legal department of 10 professionals, the Contracts team secures Pennylane’s commercial and operational relationships with customers, suppliers, partner firms, resellers, integrators and strategic partners. Reporting to the Lead Legal Counsel, Contracts , you will work closely with our Sales, Partnerships, Security, Finance and Product teams. This is a hands-on role where legal rigor, creativity and business pragmatism are equally valued. 🌍 What is Pennylane? Pennylane is one of France’s most dynamic fintech companies, currently expanding rapidly across Europe. In just six years, we have managed to: 💻 Establish ourselves in the market as an innovative provider of accounting and financial management software 💰 Raise a total of €400 million from renowned investors, including Sequoia, Silicon Valley’s leading venture capital firm, known for backing Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, PayPal, and many others in their early days 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 co-founders to a team of 1,000 employees, with an average Glassdoor rating of 4.9/5 and 94% of reviewers saying they would recommend Pennylane to their friends and family 🌍 Build an international team made up of employees from 25 different countries, with a truly flexible remote-working culture 🚀 More than 900,000 small and medium-sized businesses and over 6,000 accounting firms in France already use Pennylane! 🎯 Your role You will act as a trusted legal partner for teams across Pennylane, managing a broad range of commercial and operational agreements from drafting through to signature and post-signature follow-up. You will also help make our contracting processes more efficient and scalable, contributing to the tools, templates, playbooks and legal culture that support Pennylane’s growth. 📋 Your responsibilities International contracts Draft and negotiate purchase orders and related agreements with partner firms, primarily outside France, with a current focus on Germany. Manage contracts with strategic international suppliers. Maintain and improve templates in line with regulatory, product and business developments. Work with Sales and Partnerships to streamline the contracting process. Customer, reseller and integrator agreements Improve customer terms and conditions for SME customers across France and Europe. Support Sales with the contracting process and automated quotations. Review and negotiate agreements with Pennylane integrators and resellers. Anticipate the contractual impact of key regulations, including e-invoicing, payment services and the EU AI Act. Contribute to contract templates and playbooks. Legal operations and collaboration Structure and improve internal contracting processes to increase efficiency and scalability. Optimize our contract management tools, including Tomorro, Pivot and Notion. Identify opportunities to automate repetitive, low-value tasks, including through AI. Provide clear, pragmatic advice to Sales, Partnerships, Finance, Security and Product teams. Train non-legal teams and help build a strong legal culture across Pennylane. 🙋 The profile we are looking for You are a qualified lawyer or legal counsel with extensive experience in contract law, gained in a law firm, particularly in IP/IT, technology or SaaS, and/or in a fast-growing tech company. You are fluent in English and have a working knowledge of Franch and German. You have strong expertise in B2B SaaS agreements , including IP, indemnification, liability caps, SLAs and data-related provisions. You are autonomous and comfortable managing matters from start to finish. You have experience working in a multi-jurisdictional environment, particularly across France and Europe. You are interested in legal operations and technology, and have experience structuring processes or optimizing contract management tools. You are a genuine business partner , able to help teams move quickly while protecting the company. You are rigorous, concise and able to make complex legal topics clear to non-legal audiences. You enjoy building in a fast-moving environment where ambiguity, prioritization and rapid iteration are part of the job. You do not tick every box? Apply anyway. The most interesting profiles rarely match a job description perfectly. What matters to us is your experience, your way of thinking and your desire to help build something meaningful. 📍 Location and working model This role is available in a hybrid format from Paris or as a fully remote position elsewhere in France or Germany 🌈 Our commitment to diversity and inclusion Pennylane is committed to providing an inclusive and supportive work environment, with equal opportunities for all candidates regardless of social or ethnic background, gender, religion, sexual orientation, disability or any other personal characteristic.
